snippet.textDisplay:
Can we all acknowledge that Tom Felton has hard held up for the fans outreach to the fandom better than anyone else. Others ofc came out for reunion and other paid gigs, but Mr. Felton just in his normal life has continued to play and be silly with the community. He seemed to have always understood what we loved about the universe. 
Can y'all please, please bring this to the Stranahan. It is my closest theater. We get proper Broadway there, so I'm sure it could support the production. The only problem is we might try to keep the cast in the Toledo area for extra performances 😂❤
Other cast have done well like Evanna Lynch, but Mr. Felton just so engaged.
I hope he has loads of fun!
